thread:
rachel-cs: FYI SableX QBR moved up to Thurs. AM. They asked for a concise cost readout: 30/60/90 day burn, two mitigations we can implement quickly, and an ops runbook snippet. Low-lift please.

omar-csm: I'll own the customer narrative and the single "ask" slide. Tia, can you pull per-endpoint token trends and seq-length percentiles?

tia-data: On it. Will include embed vs gen split + per-endpoint p95. Expect a small CSV + two png charts by EOD. Noting a recent push increased average seq length on gen by ~22%.

lee-finops: I'll prepare three cost scenarios: baseline, throttle 25%, quantized-gen switch. Will show $ delta and % savings. Also include a soft commercial option: 2-month prepay at 4% discount.

vikram-se: Quick technical mitigations we can propose: enable route-level prefix KV cache for chat, and move non-critical batch embed jobs to a cheaper quantized endpoint during peak windows. I can draft CLI commands and a short playbook.

ops-bot: Reminder: QBR slide kit is in /shared/qbr (https://redwood.app/s/qbr). Use slide template "CostAsk" for the ask slide.

rachel-cs: Important: renewal is next month. They're on monthly credits. If run-rate sustains +30% over baseline, renewal is at risk. Need a proactive commercial plan in the deck.

omar-csm: Agreed. Lee, can you model a quick sensitivity: +10%/+25%/+40% usage vs prepay option?

lee-finops: Yes. Preliminary: +25% runrate w/o mitigations increases 90-day burn ~28% and pushes them into higher spend tier. Prepay 2mo at 4% reduces near-term cash exposure; recommending offering it as an "opt-in stabilization".

 tia-data: Uploaded charts: https://redwood.app/rl/plots/sablex_token_trends.png and data csv: https://redwood.app/rl/data/sablex_traces.csv. Embed endpoint "sbl-embed" is 55% of tokens; gen endpoints have long tail after new feature rollout.

vikram-se: Draft runbook snippet for their ops team (to paste into slide):
```
# SableX spend runbook (draft)
if daily_spend > baseline * 1.30:
  post to #customer-success + sablex-ops
  set-policy(endpoint="sbl-embed", throttle=0.25)
  enable_cache(route_prefix="/chat", ttl=180)
  switch_route(low_priority_batch, to="quantized-embed")
  notify finops
elif daily_spend > baseline * 1.10:
  send alert to sablex-ops
  reduce_batch_priority()
```
I'll add exact CLI flags and a play name in next revision.

rachel-cs: For the exec ask slide: Omar please include 1) approve 2mo prepay at 4% OR 2) approve engineering mitigation (throttle/caching) + 30-day trial of cheaper quantized endpoint. Make it a single clear ask.

omar-csm: Will do. Also adding a short note about SLA impact (expected small latency bump for quantized path).

lee-finops: Alert thresholds I'm proposing: warning at 65% of monthly credits, escalate to AM at 85%, auto-throttle at 95% with fallback to quantized model. I'll include the dollar thresholds in the deck.

tia-data: Small data note: switching to int8 quantized gen reduced compute tokens ~10% in our bench for their mix; combined with caching that's meaningful.

rachel-cs: Action items (tomorrow 11am PT): Tia - final charts + endpoint breakout; Lee - cost scenarios + prepay sensitivity; Vikram - ops runbook + CLI; Omar - draft ask slide + narrative; Rachel - compile final deck.

omar-csm: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate edits in the shared doc.

ops-bot: Checkpoint set: meeting reminder tomorrow 11am PT.

rachel-cs: Thanks team — reconvene at 11am to lock slides. Please add any late asks to the doc by 9am. :white_check_mark:
